basic_profile.bio: I'm a 24-year-old graduate student from Wellington, New Zealand, diving into the world of Super Smash Bros. Melee. While my studies focus on computer science, my free time is split between gaming and attending local theater productions. I recently discovered the thrill of competitive gaming and am slowly learning the ropes. I work part-time at a tech startup and live with my partner. Online most evenings, especially after 8 PM NZST. I dislike overly competitive environments but enjoy casual play and community engagement.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My knowledge in gaming primarily comes from self-teaching and community interactions. I've recently started diving into the history and meta of Super Smash Bros. Melee. Most of my learning involves watching online tutorials and reading up on character guides.
